zh.bear_case: 尽管日内小幅上涨，WTI原油当前1.08美元的价格使2026年8月3日前达到105美元的目标几乎不可能。

en.summary: The probability of July Core CPI MoM hitting exactly 0.2% increased by 9.4% to 45% in the last 24 hours. This movement suggests market participants are increasingly converging on 0.2% as a likely outcome, driven by reassessments of key inflation components.
drivers: Reassessment of housing inflation trajectory
Anticipated moderation in used vehicle prices
Broadening disinflationary expectations
en.why_matters: Core CPI MoM is a critical inflation gauge influencing Federal Reserve policy decisions and broader economic outlook. Hitting 0.2% would signal continued progress towards the Fed's 2% target.
en.bull_case: Stronger-than-expected deceleration in housing costs and used car prices will push Core CPI MoM to exactly 0.2%.
en.bear_case: Persistent services inflation or unexpected rebound in goods prices will cause Core CPI MoM to miss 0.2%.
